items.title: February 14, 2026 — Rubio addresses allies at Munich Security Conference
items.desc: 德國警方表示約25萬人在慕尼黑和平集會，呼籲結束伊朗現政權，並表達對流亡反對派領袖 Reza Pahlavi 的支持。German police say about 250,000 people gathered peacefully in Munich, calling for the end of Iran's current regime and expressing support for exiled opposition figure Reza Pahlavi.

items.title: Nvidia said Jensen Huang will not travel because of 'unforeseen circumstances'
items.desc: Nvidia 首席執行官黃仁勳因不可預見的情況取消了行程。Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang canceled his travel plans due to unforeseen circumstances.

items.title: ECB makes euro backstop global to bolster currency's role
items.desc: 歐洲央行宣布擴大歐元全球後盾機制，以加強其國際地位。The European Central Bank announced measures to expand the euro's global backstop mechanism.

items.title: 中國駐大阪總領事館呼籲國民暫勿前往日本
items.desc: 在大阪中國總領事館15日發出警告，因大阪市道頓堀發生殺傷事件，呼籲中國國民暫勿前往日本。正值春節長假期開始。

items.title: Chinese AI models festoon Spring Festival a year after DeepSeek shock
items.desc: 隨著 DeepSeek 即將推出下一代 V4 模型，許多中國 AI 公司已發布或準備發布自己的模型。With DeepSeek set to launch its next-generation V4 model, many Chinese AI firms have released or are preparing to launch their own models.

items.title: 陸黃金投資者調查：近6成是新玩家、7成不買金飾
items.desc: 中國大陸黃金投資者調查顯示，近六成是新玩家，七成不購買金飾，反映投資取向轉變。

items.title: 深水埗襲警案：尼泊爾籍男子襲擊巡邏警員被捕
items.desc: 今日凌晨2時許，深水埗醫局街發生襲警案。一名35歲尼泊爾籍男子因形迹可疑被截查時拒絕合作並襲擊警員，最終被制服。據了解該男子因無交罰款被通緝。

items.title: 德國總理默茨會見王毅：中德應展現大國擔當
items.desc: 德國總理默茨上周六在慕尼黑會見中共中央政治局委員兼外長王毅。王毅表示中德應展現大國擔當，期待德國成為中歐務實合作的推進器。

items.title: Analyst Upgrade Followed GDS Holdings (GDS) Convertible Notes Offering
items.desc: 萬國數據在摩根大通看漲評級推動下飆升 7.77%。華爾街分析師平均預計上漲空間為 11%。GDS Holdings surged 7.77% on JPMorgan's bullish rating.

items.title: Data centre operator DayOne aims to raise $5 billion in US IPO
items.desc: 萬國數據關聯公司、全球數據中心運營商 DayOne 計劃在美國 IPO 籌資高達 50 億美元。Global data centre operator DayOne, affiliated with GDS Holdings, aims to raise $5 billion in U.S. IPO.

items.title: Does GDS's New Capital Raise And DayOne IPO Plan Change The Bull Case?
items.desc: 萬國數據預測顯示公允價值為 48.30 美元，較現價有 5% 上漲空間。Forecasts yield a $48.30 fair value, a 5% upside.

items.title: Vanguard lifted its stake in shares of GDS by 9.7%
items.desc: Vanguard 個人化指數管理公司在第三季度增持萬國數據股份 9.7%。Vanguard lifted its stake by 9.7% in Q3.

items.title: OpenAI accuses China's DeepSeek of stealing AI technology
items.desc: OpenAI 指控 DeepSeek 使用不公平方法從美國 AI 模型提取結果來訓練其 R1 聊天機器人。OpenAI warned lawmakers that DeepSeek is using unfair methods including distillation techniques.

items.title: China delivers another 'DeepSeek moment' — this time for Hollywood
items.desc: Seedance 2.0 視頻生成模型以電影級真實感令人驚嘆，引發與製片廠的版權衝突。Seedance 2.0 video generation model stuns with cinematic realism, sparking copyright clash.

items.title: OpenAI and Anthropic spark coding revolution
items.desc: OpenAI 和 Anthropic 分別發布 GPT-5.3-Codex 和 Claude Opus 4.6，引發編程革命。GPT-5.3-Codex and Claude Opus 4.6 represent significant leaps in AI coding capabilities.

items.title: OpenAI Retires GPT-4o Again, Stirring Backlash
items.desc: OpenAI 於 2 月 13 日正式停用 GPT-4o，令許多用戶感到驚訝。OpenAI officially retired GPT-4o on February 13, surprising many users.

items.title: OpenAI rolls out new model built for speed, coding on Cerebras chips
items.desc: OpenAI 推出首款運行於 Cerebras 芯片的 AI 模型。OpenAI is releasing its first AI model that runs on Cerebras Systems chips, broadening beyond Nvidia.

items.title: Security experts are uneasy about OpenClaw
items.desc: OpenClaw 賦予 AI Agent 真正的自主權，但同時帶來新的安全風險。OpenClaw gives AI agents real autonomy — and raises new security risks.

items.title: OpenClaw Security: Over 30,000 exposed instances detected
items.desc: 研究發現僅 1 月 27 日至 2 月 8 日期間就觀察到超過 30,000 個暴露的 OpenClaw 實例。Over 30,000 OpenClaw instances observed from Jan 27 to Feb 8.

items.title: OpenClaw Scanner detects autonomous AI agents
items.desc: 一款新的免費開源工具可幫助檢測自主 AI Agent。A new free, open source tool is available to detect autonomous AI agents.

items.title: US military used Anthropic's Claude in Venezuela raid
items.desc: 美軍在抓捕委內瑞拉馬杜羅的行動中使用了 Claude。The US military used Claude in the operation to capture Venezuela's Nicolás Maduro.

items.title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Health
items.desc: OpenAI 推出 ChatGPT Health，用戶可連接患者門戶和 Apple Health。Users can link patient portals, Apple Health to ask questions grounded in their lab results.
